source: MAFF / ADB, "សណ្តែកបាយ" [Bean crop — mung bean and black gram], official cultivation manual, 2005 (mung bean sections)
text: Harvest guidance is given jointly with black gram (see the black_gram product entry for the parallel content), and the manual reports mung bean yield data from Cambodian growing conditions in the range of roughly 560–1,500 kg/ha, with an average cited around 800–1,050 kg/ha depending on variety and management level described in the source.
